content:
sara.dev: Heads-up — publish window today 16:00-18:00 PT. Plan: publish py/ts SDK 1.28.0, canary at 5% traffic, then ramp to 25% if no regressions. also deprecate legacy sync client with migration notes. need final signoff and backout rules.

mike.releases: ack. I'll own the publish and monitoring. quick checklist: CI green, staging smoke, docs updated, pin strategy for older clients. I'll run canary job at T+10m.

jamie.qa: staging smoke is green for core generation + streaming. I need ~15m after canary to run embedding and large-seq tests. Marking flaky test suite to ignore during canary to avoid false positives.

lee.infra: pls set publish concurrency to 2 for registry pushes and enable retry backoff 5s/20s. Also suggest putting the canary in us-west1 only for the first ramp.

olga.docs: I pushed a short migration blurb to the draft release notes (link: https://docs.internal/release/1.28.0). Will update deprecation paragraph once we decide the pin window.

sara.dev: Backout & rollback rules (proposed):
1) Immediate rollback if 5xx rate > 1.5% or error-rate spike + user-facing failures for 5m.
2) If latency p95 increases > 40% for 10m rollback canary.
3) If cost-per-token increases > 25% unexpectedly -> pause and revert.
4) If we see model-mismatch regressions on eval prompts -> revert.

Rollback commands (quick reference):
```bash
# npm: move dist-tag to previous stable
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.27.9 latest
# npm unpublish isn't used for public packages in prod windows

# pypi: publish a patch with yanked flag or reassign last tag in our internal registry
# example internal registry rollback (private):
# set previous artifact as 'active' in registry UI or API

# if we must block clients immediately: update routing rule to route to previously pinned model/service
# infra command (internal):
redwoodctl route set --service sdk --target stable-20231109
```

mike.releases: +1 on those rules. Two operational notes: 1) We'll hold a 15-minute manual gate at 25% ramp to allow QA to sign off. 2) If we rollback, we should post a short deprecation/pin note to #general and to customers with affected integrations.

jamie.qa: I'll run a targeted eval after canary start: 1000 prompt set against py and ts clients. If drift > 3% on our quality metric I'll request halt.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: canary-publish-sdk-1.28.0 (initiated by mike.releases). Steps: build -> publish-canary -> smoke-check -> telemetry-watch.

lee.infra: I've set concurrency=2 and limited region to us-west1 for the canary. Also enabled additional logging for prefix cache hits.

mike.releases: starting canary now. will post timestamps.

deploy-bot: build passed. publish step started for @redwood/sdk@1.28.0-canary.

mike.releases: canary published. URL to inner test registry: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/sdk/1.28.0-canary. running smoke check.

jamie.qa: smoke checks passed. starting eval run (embedding + gen + streaming). ETA ~12m.

olga.docs: updating release notes with migration snippet: "Use new async client and migrate away from sync client by end of quarter. See code samples." Will add a short upgrade table.

jamie.qa: eval complete — quality delta within tolerance (0.7% overall), latency p95 +8% (ok), no 5xx observed.

mike.releases: ramping to 25% in 5m. holding manual gate at +15m for signoff.

sara.dev: reminder: pin for older customers — propose we pin legacy sync client in our registry under tag `legacy-sync-2024-09` and keep it available for 90 days before yanking. olga, can you add the deprecation timeline?

olga.docs: added timeline + example migration steps. will publish with release notes when final.

deploy-bot: canary ramp to 25% completed. telemetry metrics OK (error-rate 0.2%, latency p95 +10%).

mike.releases: manual gate — waiting on jamie and sara.

jamie.qa: signoff from QA. no critical issues.

sara.dev: signoff from product/devex. Proceed to full rollout after 30m observation.

mike.releases: great. schedule: full rollout at T+45m if steady. I'll prepare the changelog announcement and npm/pypi tag flips.

lee.infra: FYI I left the extra logging on for 1 hour post-rollout. will revert if noisy.

mike.releases: final note on pinning: ops will add `legacy-sync-2024-09` tag and expose a migration guide. If anyone sees instability after full rollout, we revert to stable-1.27.9 and we run hotfix branch.

sara.dev: thanks all. I'll draft the short customer-facing blurb for the deprecation and email list. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: full rollout started (initiated by mike.releases). progress updates will follow.
